### Notes and sources

#### E1 Conformance kit for third-party adapters {#dim-e1}

- <a id="fn-codespec-e1"></a>**codespec** yes: conformance kit (conformance/kit.json, 128 feature ids, one case each) and codespec conform with per-feature verdicts; adapter manifest via --describe [website/docs/guides/add-an-adapter.md:88-97](<https://github.com/beyond10x/codespec/blob/70c6c4ebc42c/website/docs/guides/add-an-adapter.md#L88-L97>)
- <a id="fn-codeql-e1"></a>**CodeQL** unknown: No published conformance kit for third-party extractors found in sources read.
- <a id="fn-semgrep-ce-e1"></a>**Semgrep CE** partial: Guide for adding a language: parsing tests and pattern tests (source file, .sgrep pattern, ERROR comments); no feature vocabulary or verdicts. [docs.semgrep.dev](<https://docs.semgrep.dev/contributing/adding-a-language>)
- <a id="fn-semgrep-pro-e1"></a>**Semgrep Pro** partial: Language-adding guide with parsing and pattern tests applies to the open engine; no Pro-specific kit and no feature verdicts. [docs.semgrep.dev](<https://docs.semgrep.dev/contributing/adding-a-language>)
- <a id="fn-joern-e1"></a>**Joern** unknown: The page read does not say it. [docs.joern.io](<https://docs.joern.io/>)
- <a id="fn-infer-e1"></a>**Infer** unknown: No published conformance kit for frontend authors found.
- <a id="fn-sonarqube-e1"></a>**SonarQube** unknown: No published adapter conformance kit found.
- <a id="fn-snyk-code-e1"></a>**Snyk Code** unknown: No published adapter conformance kit found.
- <a id="fn-coverity-e1"></a>**Coverity** unknown: No readable page on an adapter conformance kit.
- <a id="fn-doop-e1"></a>**Doop (Soufflé)** unknown: The page read does not say it. [github.com](<https://github.com/plast-lab/doop>)
- <a id="fn-glean-e1"></a>**Glean** unknown: The page read does not say it. [glean.software](<https://glean.software/docs/introduction/>)
- <a id="fn-scip-e1"></a>**SCIP** partial: scip test validates an index against human-readable test files and scip snapshot supports golden tests; no feature vocabulary or per-feature verdicts. [raw.githubusercontent.com](<https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sourcegraph/scip/main/docs/CLI.md>)
- <a id="fn-go-analysis-e1"></a>**staticcheck / go/analysis** partial: analysistest checks analyzers against testdata with // want comments; no conformance kit for front ends or drivers. [pkg.go.dev](<https://pkg.go.dev/golang.org/x/tools/go/analysis/analysistest>)
- <a id="fn-spotbugs-e1"></a>**SpotBugs** partial: Plugin guide gives a test harness (performAnalysis, BugInstanceMatcher) for detectors; no feature vocabulary and nothing for front ends. [spotbugs.readthedocs.io](<https://spotbugs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/implement-plugin.html>)
- <a id="fn-errorprone-e1"></a>**Error Prone** partial: CompilationTestHelper and BugCheckerRefactoringTestHelper test checkers; no kit for front ends or feature vocabulary. [errorprone.info](<https://errorprone.info/api/latest/com/google/errorprone/package-summary.html>)
- <a id="fn-clang-sa-e1"></a>**Clang SA / tidy** partial: check\_clang\_tidy.py with lit tests (CHECK-MESSAGES, CHECK-FIXES) tests checks in-tree; no kit for outside front ends. [clang.llvm.org](<https://clang.llvm.org/extra/clang-tidy/Contributing.html>)
- <a id="fn-capslock-e1"></a>**Capslock** unknown: No published conformance kit for adapters found.
- <a id="fn-ast-grep-e1"></a>**ast-grep** unknown: Add-language guide mentions no test kit or conformance suite; not stated either way.
- <a id="fn-openrewrite-e1"></a>**OpenRewrite** unknown: No conformance kit for third-party front ends documented in pages read.
- <a id="fn-comby-e1"></a>**Comby** unknown: No conformance kit documented; custom languages are a JSON description only.
- <a id="fn-gritql-e1"></a>**GritQL** unknown: No adapter conformance kit documented.
- <a id="fn-coccinelle-e1"></a>**Coccinelle** unknown: No kit for third-party front ends documented; the test kit checks semantic patches against expected results.

#### E2 Documented determinism {#dim-e2}

- <a id="fn-codespec-e2"></a>**codespec** yes: Same source read twice gives the same bytes (task examples-check); results sorted, witness paths the least shortest, effects report canonical JSON [AGENTS.md:65](<https://github.com/beyond10x/codespec/blob/70c6c4ebc42c/AGENTS.md#L65>)
- <a id="fn-codeql-e2"></a>**CodeQL** unknown: No statement of byte-identical output found; docs only warn sarif-latest varies between CodeQL versions.
- <a id="fn-semgrep-ce-e2"></a>**Semgrep CE** unknown: No statement of byte-identical output found.
- <a id="fn-semgrep-pro-e2"></a>**Semgrep Pro** unknown: No statement of byte-identical output found.
- <a id="fn-joern-e2"></a>**Joern** unknown: The page read does not say it. [docs.joern.io](<https://docs.joern.io/>)
- <a id="fn-infer-e2"></a>**Infer** no: Docs state non-determinism exists: replay-analysis-schedule option "should drastically limit non-determinism in the results"; no byte-identical guarantee stated. [fbinfer.com](<https://fbinfer.com/man/next/infer-analyze.1.html>)
- <a id="fn-sonarqube-e2"></a>**SonarQube** unknown: No determinism statement found.
- <a id="fn-snyk-code-e2"></a>**Snyk Code** unknown: No determinism statement for scan results found.
- <a id="fn-coverity-e2"></a>**Coverity** unknown: No determinism statement found on readable pages.
- <a id="fn-doop-e2"></a>**Doop (Soufflé)** unknown: The page read does not say it. [github.com](<https://github.com/plast-lab/doop>)
- <a id="fn-glean-e2"></a>**Glean** unknown: The page read does not say it. [glean.software](<https://glean.software/docs/introduction/>)
- <a id="fn-scip-e2"></a>**SCIP** partial: Indexer guide recommends making indexing deterministic and checking it with snapshots; a recommendation to indexer authors, not a guarantee. [sourcegraph.com](<https://sourcegraph.com/docs/code-search/code-navigation/writing_an_indexer>)
- <a id="fn-go-analysis-e2"></a>**staticcheck / go/analysis** partial: Fact gob encoding 'must be deterministic'; unitchecker is ideally 'a pure function from input files to output files'; fact iteration order is unspecified. [pkg.go.dev](<https://pkg.go.dev/golang.org/x/tools/go/analysis>)
- <a id="fn-spotbugs-e2"></a>**SpotBugs** unknown: FAQ and manual pages read say nothing about deterministic or reproducible output.
- <a id="fn-errorprone-e2"></a>**Error Prone** unknown: No determinism statement found in the docs read.
- <a id="fn-clang-sa-e2"></a>**Clang SA / tidy** partial: Stated for part of the output: analyzer report filenames are 'now always stable'. No whole-output statement found. [clang.llvm.org](<https://clang.llvm.org/docs/analyzer/user-docs/Options.html>)
- <a id="fn-capslock-e2"></a>**Capslock** partial: JSON output includes moduleInfo with dependency versions "in order to make the analysis reproducible"; byte-identical output is not stated. [raw.githubusercontent.com](<https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/capslock/main/docs/examples.md>)
- <a id="fn-ast-grep-e2"></a>**ast-grep** unknown: How-it-works page makes no claim about deterministic output.
- <a id="fn-openrewrite-e2"></a>**OpenRewrite** unknown: No byte-identical determinism statement for the engine found; README says only "repeatable".
- <a id="fn-comby-e2"></a>**Comby** unknown: No statement on byte-identical output; config patterns run in alphabetical order by name.
- <a id="fn-gritql-e2"></a>**GritQL** unknown: No byte-identical determinism statement found.
- <a id="fn-coccinelle-e2"></a>**Coccinelle** unknown: No byte-identical determinism statement found; parallel jobs merge output of several processes.

#### E3 Licence {#dim-e3}

- <a id="fn-codespec-e3"></a>**codespec** Apache-2.0 (engine, readers, writers) [README.md:105](<https://github.com/beyond10x/codespec/blob/70c6c4ebc42c/README.md#L105>)
- <a id="fn-codeql-e3"></a>**CodeQL** Libraries and queries: MIT (github/codeql repo). CLI binaries: GitHub CodeQL Terms; free for open source on GitHub, automation on private code needs Advanced Security. [github.com](<https://github.com/github/codeql-cli-binaries/blob/main/LICENSE.md>)
- <a id="fn-semgrep-ce-e3"></a>**Semgrep CE** Engine: LGPL 2.1. Semgrep-maintained rules: Semgrep Rules License v1.0 (internal business use, not open source); third-party rules keep their own licences. [docs.semgrep.dev](<https://docs.semgrep.dev/licensing/>)
- <a id="fn-semgrep-pro-e3"></a>**Semgrep Pro** Semgrep Code and AppSec Platform: proprietary, Terms of Service. Free for up to 10 contributors. Rules: Semgrep Rules License v1.0. [docs.semgrep.dev](<https://docs.semgrep.dev/licensing/>)
- <a id="fn-joern-e3"></a>**Joern** Apache-2.0 (engine, frontends and query database in one repository) [github.com](<https://github.com/joernio/joern>)
- <a id="fn-infer-e3"></a>**Infer** MIT; README notes Java support may need downloaded components licensed under the GPL. [github.com](<https://github.com/facebook/infer>)
- <a id="fn-sonarqube-e3"></a>**SonarQube** Community Build engine: LGPL-3.0. Paid Server editions add taint, SCA and more; their licence text is not on the cited page. [github.com](<https://github.com/SonarSource/sonarqube>)
- <a id="fn-snyk-code-e3"></a>**Snyk Code** Proprietary service and tools under Snyk terms of service: non-exclusive use right, no reverse engineering. [snyk.io](<https://snyk.io/policies/terms-of-service/>)
- <a id="fn-coverity-e3"></a>**Coverity** Commercial: governed by the vendor End User Software License and Maintenance Agreement; SDK under a separate addendum. [www.blackduck.com](<https://www.blackduck.com/company/legal/end-user-licenses.html>)
- <a id="fn-doop-e3"></a>**Doop (Soufflé)** Doop: Universal Permissive License 1.0 (UPL); Soufflé engine: UPL 1.0; bundled Scaler and Zipper under their own licence file [raw.githubusercontent.com](<https://raw.githubusercontent.com/plast-lab/doop/master/LICENSE>)
- <a id="fn-glean-e3"></a>**Glean** BSD 3-Clause [raw.githubusercontent.com](<https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebookincubator/Glean/main/LICENSE>)
- <a id="fn-scip-e3"></a>**SCIP** Apache-2.0 for the protocol, CLI and bindings; indexers named in the README are also Apache-2.0 where checked. [github.com](<https://github.com/scip-code/scip>)
- <a id="fn-go-analysis-e3"></a>**staticcheck / go/analysis** x/tools (go/analysis): BSD-3-Clause. Staticcheck: MIT (its own LICENSE file). [raw.githubusercontent.com](<https://raw.githubusercontent.com/golang/tools/master/LICENSE>)
- <a id="fn-spotbugs-e3"></a>**SpotBugs** LGPL-2.1 for the engine; Find Security Bugs plugin is also LGPL per its site. [github.com](<https://github.com/spotbugs/spotbugs/blob/master/LICENSE>)
- <a id="fn-errorprone-e3"></a>**Error Prone** Apache-2.0. [github.com](<https://github.com/google/error-prone>)
- <a id="fn-clang-sa-e3"></a>**Clang SA / tidy** Apache License v2.0 with LLVM Exceptions (legacy NCSA for older code); CodeChecker is out of tree. [llvm.org](<https://llvm.org/LICENSE.txt>)
- <a id="fn-capslock-e3"></a>**Capslock** BSD-3-Clause. [github.com](<https://github.com/google/capslock/blob/main/LICENSE>)
- <a id="fn-ast-grep-e3"></a>**ast-grep** MIT (engine); rule catalogue examples in docs, no separate rule licence stated. [github.com](<https://github.com/ast-grep/ast-grep>)
- <a id="fn-openrewrite-e3"></a>**OpenRewrite** Apache-2.0 for core, Java, Kotlin, Groovy and plugins; Moderne Source Available License for many recipe and newer language modules; proprietary for some. [docs.openrewrite.org](<https://docs.openrewrite.org/licensing/openrewrite-licensing>)
- <a id="fn-comby-e3"></a>**Comby** Apache-2.0. [github.com](<https://github.com/comby-tools/comby>)
- <a id="fn-gritql-e3"></a>**GritQL** MIT (engine and CLI); the standard library patterns repository is "licensed exclusively for usage with the Grit tool. All rights reserved." [github.com](<https://github.com/getgrit/gritql>)
- <a id="fn-coccinelle-e3"></a>**Coccinelle** GPL-2.0. [github.com](<https://github.com/coccinelle/coccinelle>)

#### E4 Self-hosted and offline {#dim-e4}

- <a id="fn-codespec-e4"></a>**codespec** yes: Local command line and adapter programs from a release archive or source build; no vendor service and no model in the pipeline [README.md:48-57](<https://github.com/beyond10x/codespec/blob/70c6c4ebc42c/README.md#L48-L57>)
- <a id="fn-codeql-e4"></a>**CodeQL** partial: CLI runs locally on own machine; licence limits private-code automation to a paid GitHub licence; Autofix is GitHub-hosted only. [docs.github.com](<https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/codeql-cli/getting-started-with-the-codeql-cli/about-the-codeql-cli>)
- <a id="fn-semgrep-ce-e4"></a>**Semgrep CE** yes: Source and private rules "never leave your environment"; local rules with --metrics off need no network. [docs.semgrep.dev](<https://docs.semgrep.dev/metrics>)
- <a id="fn-semgrep-pro-e4"></a>**Semgrep Pro** partial: Scans run in the user's CI and code is not sent, but Pro needs a platform account, the Pro binary download and sign-in. [docs.semgrep.dev](<https://docs.semgrep.dev/semgrep-code/semgrep-pro-engine-intro>)
- <a id="fn-joern-e4"></a>**Joern** yes: Runs locally from release zips, Docker or install script; local server mode; JDK 21 required [github.com](<https://github.com/joernio/joern>)
- <a id="fn-infer-e4"></a>**Infer** yes: Infer wraps the user's own build commands locally and writes results to infer-out; no vendor service is involved. [fbinfer.com](<https://fbinfer.com/docs/analyzing-apps-or-projects>)
- <a id="fn-sonarqube-e4"></a>**SonarQube** yes: Scanner runs on your CI host and sends results to your SonarQube Server; Community Build is the free self-managed engine. [docs.sonarsource.com](<https://docs.sonarsource.com/sonarqube-server/discovering/analysis-overview/process-steps>)
- <a id="fn-snyk-code-e4"></a>**Snyk Code** no: Default scan sends bundled files to Snyk; Local Engine avoids code upload but is deprecated and no longer onboards new deployments. [docs.snyk.io](<https://docs.snyk.io/scan-fix-and-prevent/scan-with-snyk/snyk-code/snyk-code-local-engine>)
- <a id="fn-coverity-e4"></a>**Coverity** yes: Offers a fully air-gapped on-premises deployment including Kubernetes cluster support. [www.blackduck.com](<https://www.blackduck.com/static-analysis-tools-sast/coverity.html>)
- <a id="fn-doop-e4"></a>**Doop (Soufflé)** yes: Runs locally via Gradle, binary distribution, doopOffline script or Docker image; Soufflé compiles to local C++ [raw.githubusercontent.com](<https://raw.githubusercontent.com/plast-lab/doop/master/README.md>)
- <a id="fn-glean-e4"></a>**Glean** yes: Local databases with --db-root, --db-tmp or --db-memory; own server; Docker demo; S3 is optional backup [glean.software](<https://glean.software/docs/databases/>)
- <a id="fn-scip-e4"></a>**SCIP** yes: Indexers run locally and write index.scip; uploading to a service is a separate optional step. [github.com](<https://github.com/sourcegraph/scip-clang>)
- <a id="fn-go-analysis-e4"></a>**staticcheck / go/analysis** yes: Runs locally: 'staticcheck ./...' behaves like the go tool; analyzers run inside go vet. No vendor service involved. [staticcheck.dev](<https://staticcheck.dev/docs/>)
- <a id="fn-spotbugs-e4"></a>**SpotBugs** yes: 'Can be used standalone and through several integrations'; runs as a local Java program on class files. [github.com](<https://github.com/spotbugs/spotbugs>)
- <a id="fn-errorprone-e4"></a>**Error Prone** yes: Runs inside the user's own javac build as a compiler plugin; no service involved. [errorprone.info](<https://errorprone.info/docs/installation>)
- <a id="fn-clang-sa-e4"></a>**Clang SA / tidy** yes: Local tools: clang --analyze, scan-build and clang-tidy run on the user's machine over a compilation database. [clang.llvm.org](<https://clang.llvm.org/docs/analyzer/user-docs/CommandLineUsage.html>)
- <a id="fn-capslock-e4"></a>**Capslock** yes: Local CLI installed with go install, run from the package path; loads packages through the local Go toolchain. [github.com](<https://github.com/google/capslock>)
- <a id="fn-ast-grep-e4"></a>**ast-grep** yes: Open source CLI installable via cargo, npm, pip, brew; runs locally on files. [github.com](<https://github.com/ast-grep/ast-grep>)
- <a id="fn-openrewrite-e4"></a>**OpenRewrite** partial: Engine and plugins run locally under Apache-2.0; security and program-analysis recipes need the proprietary Moderne tier; Code Genome repository needs a token. [docs.openrewrite.org](<https://docs.openrewrite.org/licensing/openrewrite-licensing>)
- <a id="fn-comby-e4"></a>**Comby** yes: Local CLI (brew, Docker, source) and optional self-built comby-server; no vendor service. [comby.dev](<https://comby.dev/docs/get-started>)
- <a id="fn-gritql-e4"></a>**GritQL** partial: Engine and grit check run locally under MIT; some options (--remote, --ai) and hosted GitHub App checks use Grit services. [docs.grit.io](<https://docs.grit.io/cli/reference>)
- <a id="fn-coccinelle-e4"></a>**Coccinelle** yes: Local command spatch; build from source, packages or pre-compiled binaries; no vendor service. [github.com](<https://github.com/coccinelle/coccinelle>)

#### E5 CI integration {#dim-e5}

- <a id="fn-codespec-e5"></a>**codespec** partial: Command line with exit codes 0 (none), 1 (findings), 2 (error); no published CI action or integration guide for users [website/docs/reference/cli.md:199](<https://github.com/beyond10x/codespec/blob/70c6c4ebc42c/website/docs/reference/cli.md#L199>)
- <a id="fn-codeql-e5"></a>**CodeQL** yes: Official CodeQL action; CLI guide for other CI systems (database create, analyze, upload). [github.com](<https://github.com/github/codeql-action>)
- <a id="fn-semgrep-ce-e5"></a>**Semgrep CE** yes: CE CI guide with templates for GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Bitbucket, Buildkite, CircleCI, Azure Pipelines; Docker image. [docs.semgrep.dev](<https://docs.semgrep.dev/deployment/oss-deployment>)
- <a id="fn-semgrep-pro-e5"></a>**Semgrep Pro** yes: Guided setup for GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, Bitbucket, CircleCI, Buildkite, Azure Pipelines, Semaphore; semgrep ci command. [docs.semgrep.dev](<https://docs.semgrep.dev/semgrep-ci/overview>)
- <a id="fn-joern-e5"></a>**Joern** partial: Command line joern-scan; site tagline "Automatic Scans. On desktop, and in your CI." with no CI guide or action [joern.io](<https://joern.io/automate/>)
- <a id="fn-infer-e5"></a>**Infer** yes: Recommended flow for CI page: changed-files reactive analysis, reportdiff, --fail-on-issue exit code. [fbinfer.com](<https://fbinfer.com/docs/steps-for-ci/>)
- <a id="fn-sonarqube-e5"></a>**SonarQube** yes: Documented CI integration: GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipelines, GitLab CI/CD, Azure Pipelines, Jenkins, Codemagic, others. [docs.sonarsource.com](<https://docs.sonarsource.com/sonarqube-server/analyzing-source-code/ci-integration>)
- <a id="fn-snyk-code-e5"></a>**Snyk Code** yes: Run Snyk Code in CI through the Snyk CLI; fail jobs by severity; export results. [docs.snyk.io](<https://docs.snyk.io/developer-tools/integrations/snyk-ci-cd-integrations/use-snyk-code-in-the-ci-cd-pipeline>)
- <a id="fn-coverity-e5"></a>**Coverity** yes: Vendor Jenkins plugin runs cov-build, cov-analyze, cov-commit-defects and can fail or mark the build unstable on defects (plugin now deprecated). [github.com](<https://github.com/jenkinsci/coverity-plugin/blob/master/README.md>)
- <a id="fn-doop-e5"></a>**Doop (Soufflé)** partial: Command line and Docker images; no CI action or CI guide for users documented (its own CI is Java CI with Gradle) [raw.githubusercontent.com](<https://raw.githubusercontent.com/plast-lab/doop/master/README.md>)
- <a id="fn-glean-e5"></a>**Glean** partial: Command line (glean create, index, finish) run by periodic jobs; no CI action or CI guide for users [glean.software](<https://glean.software/docs/databases/>)
- <a id="fn-scip-e5"></a>**SCIP** yes: scip-typescript README says it is mostly run in CI: install, index, upload steps given for GitHub workflows. [github.com](<https://github.com/sourcegraph/scip-typescript>)
- <a id="fn-go-analysis-e5"></a>**staticcheck / go/analysis** yes: Staticcheck documents an official GitHub Action; go vet -vettool runs any analyzer binary in a go-vet CI step. [staticcheck.dev](<https://staticcheck.dev/docs/running-staticcheck/ci/github-actions/>)
- <a id="fn-spotbugs-e5"></a>**SpotBugs** yes: Documented Maven plugin (spotbugs, check goals), Gradle plugin, Ant task and SonarQube integration; check goal fails the build on bugs. [spotbugs.readthedocs.io](<https://spotbugs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/maven.html>)
- <a id="fn-errorprone-e5"></a>**Error Prone** yes: Documented integration with Bazel, Maven, Gradle and Ant builds, so it runs wherever the build runs. [errorprone.info](<https://errorprone.info/docs/installation>)
- <a id="fn-clang-sa-e5"></a>**Clang SA / tidy** partial: Command line: scan-build, run-clang-tidy and clang-tidy-diff; no official CI action or CI guide in the pages read. [clang.llvm.org](<https://clang.llvm.org/docs/analyzer/user-docs/CommandLineUsage.html>)
- <a id="fn-capslock-e5"></a>**Capslock** partial: Command line only: JSON baseline and compare mode with distinct exit codes (1 for a difference); no official action or CI guide. [raw.githubusercontent.com](<https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/capslock/main/cmd/capslock/capslock.go>)
- <a id="fn-ast-grep-e5"></a>**ast-grep** yes: Official GitHub Action ast-grep/action; scan exits non-zero on error severity; --format github. [github.com](<https://github.com/ast-grep/action>)
- <a id="fn-openrewrite-e5"></a>**OpenRewrite** yes: Maven and Gradle plugins with dryRun and failOnDryRunResults to gate CI. [docs.openrewrite.org](<https://docs.openrewrite.org/reference/rewrite-maven-plugin>)
- <a id="fn-comby-e5"></a>**Comby** partial: Command line and Docker image; CI is not covered by the get-started page, no official action found. [comby.dev](<https://comby.dev/docs/get-started>)
- <a id="fn-gritql-e5"></a>**GritQL** yes: CI guide: GitHub Action getgrit/github-action-check, GitHub App checks, grit check --github-actions annotations. [docs.grit.io](<https://docs.grit.io/guides/ci>)
- <a id="fn-coccinelle-e5"></a>**Coccinelle** partial: Command line only (spatch, coccicheck scripts); the page found documents no CI guide. [coccinelle.gitlabpages.inria.fr](<https://coccinelle.gitlabpages.inria.fr/website/coccicheck.html>)

#### E6 Output formats {#dim-e6}

- <a id="fn-codespec-e6"></a>**codespec** text and JSON (codespec-check-report/1, query-report/1, effects-report/1 and others); no SARIF in the command line source [website/docs/reference/cli.md:210](<https://github.com/beyond10x/codespec/blob/70c6c4ebc42c/website/docs/reference/cli.md#L210>)
- <a id="fn-codeql-e6"></a>**CodeQL** csv, sarif-latest, sarifv2.1.0, graphtext, dgml, dot (graph formats only for @kind graph queries). [docs.github.com](<https://docs.github.com/code-security/codeql-cli/manual/database-analyze/>)
- <a id="fn-semgrep-ce-e6"></a>**Semgrep CE** json, sarif, junit-xml, gitlab-sast, emacs, vim, text; each with a matching output-file flag. [docs.semgrep.dev](<https://docs.semgrep.dev/cli-reference>)
- <a id="fn-semgrep-pro-e6"></a>**Semgrep Pro** json, sarif, junit-xml, gitlab-sast, emacs, vim, text; platform adds fingerprint fields (JSON extra.fingerprint, SARIF fingerprints). [docs.semgrep.dev](<https://docs.semgrep.dev/semgrep-appsec-platform/json-and-sarif>)
- <a id="fn-joern-e6"></a>**Joern** joern-export: dot, Neo4j CSV, GraphML, GraphSON; joern-scan prints plain text lines; toJson step in the shell [docs.joern.io](<https://docs.joern.io/export>)
- <a id="fn-infer-e6"></a>**Infer** report.json, report.txt, SARIF (--sarif), PMD XML (--pmd-xml), HTML via infer explore, differential JSON files. [fbinfer.com](<https://fbinfer.com/man/next/infer-run.1.html>)
- <a id="fn-sonarqube-e6"></a>**SonarQube** Web API responses are JSON (sample shown); in-product Web API reference. SARIF and generic issue format documented for import only. [docs.sonarsource.com](<https://docs.sonarsource.com/sonarqube-server/extension-guide/web-api>)
- <a id="fn-snyk-code-e6"></a>**Snyk Code** JSON (--json), SARIF (--sarif), HTML (--html) from snyk code test. [docs.snyk.io](<https://docs.snyk.io/developer-tools/snyk-cli/commands/code-test>)
- <a id="fn-coverity-e6"></a>**Coverity** cov-format-errors: HTML and emacs-style text (vendor blog); JSON v7 and v8 (vendor repository). [www.blackduck.com](<https://www.blackduck.com/blog/running-codexm-checker-with-coverity.html>)
- <a id="fn-doop-e6"></a>**Doop (Soufflé)** Relation result files (CSV, via Soufflé output) and SARIF with --sarif for VS Code; Soufflé itself also writes SQLite and stdout [raw.githubusercontent.com](<https://raw.githubusercontent.com/plast-lab/doop/master/README.md>)
- <a id="fn-glean-e6"></a>**Glean** glean list: tty, plain, json, compact-json; query results in the schema's Thrift JSON form; query output to file with -o [glean.software](<https://glean.software/docs/cli/>)
- <a id="fn-scip-e6"></a>**SCIP** Protobuf binary index.scip; scip print --json; snapshot text files; experimental SQLite via scip expt-convert. [raw.githubusercontent.com](<https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sourcegraph/scip/main/docs/CLI.md>)
- <a id="fn-go-analysis-e6"></a>**staticcheck / go/analysis** go/analysis: plain text and -json. Staticcheck: text, stylish, json, binary; source also accepts sarif though the -f help text omits it. [github.com](<https://github.com/dominikh/go-tools/blob/master/lintcmd/cmd.go>)
- <a id="fn-spotbugs-e6"></a>**SpotBugs** CLI: XML, XML with messages, HTML (XSLT), SARIF 2.1.0, Emacs, xdocs, text. Ant task page lists no SARIF. [spotbugs.readthedocs.io](<https://spotbugs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/running.html>)
- <a id="fn-errorprone-e6"></a>**Error Prone** javac diagnostics and a unified diff patch (error-prone.patch); the flags page documents no output-format flags. [errorprone.info](<https://errorprone.info/docs/patching>)
- <a id="fn-clang-sa-e6"></a>**Clang SA / tidy** Analyzer: plist (default), plist-multi-file, plist-html, html, sarif, sarif-html, text. clang-tidy: text, experimental SARIF, YAML fixes. [clang.llvm.org](<https://clang.llvm.org/docs/analyzer/user-docs/CommandLineUsage.html>)
- <a id="fn-capslock-e6"></a>**Capslock** Default count summary, -v verbose call chains, JSON (protojson), -output=m capability list, package mode, graph (DOT), compare text. [raw.githubusercontent.com](<https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/capslock/main/docs/examples.md>)
- <a id="fn-ast-grep-e6"></a>**ast-grep** JSON (pretty, stream, compact), SARIF, GitHub Actions annotations, rich/medium/short text reports. [ast-grep.github.io](<https://ast-grep.github.io/reference/cli/scan.html>)
- <a id="fn-openrewrite-e6"></a>**OpenRewrite** Git-style rewrite.patch (dryRun), CSV data tables (exportDatatables), build log output. [docs.openrewrite.org](<https://docs.openrewrite.org/reference/rewrite-maven-plugin>)
- <a id="fn-comby-e6"></a>**Comby** JSON lines (matches, rewrites), patch-compatible diff, -json-only-diff, rewritten source, in-place edit. [comby.dev](<https://comby.dev/docs/api>)
- <a id="fn-gritql-e6"></a>**GritQL** JSON and JSONL (global flags, some commands), standard and compact text, GitHub Actions annotations; SARIF not documented. [docs.grit.io](<https://docs.grit.io/cli/reference>)
- <a id="fn-coccinelle-e6"></a>**Coccinelle** Unified diff (default), in-place file, .cocci-res file, CFG as dot, CSV import of external analyses; script rules can print anything. [coccinelle.gitlabpages.inria.fr](<https://coccinelle.gitlabpages.inria.fr/website/docs/options.pdf>)

#### E7 Ships a maintained rule catalogue {#dim-e7}

- <a id="fn-codespec-e7"></a>**codespec** partial: 18 built-in checks (codespec check); the repository's record of running them on one public test repository shows 8 findings, all false [docs/checks-capslock.md:47-69](<https://github.com/beyond10x/codespec/blob/70c6c4ebc42c/docs/checks-capslock.md#L47-L69>)
- <a id="fn-codeql-e7"></a>**CodeQL** yes: GitHub creates and maintains built-in query suites: default, security-extended, security-and-quality. [docs.github.com](<https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/code-scanning/managing-your-code-scanning-configuration/codeql-query-suites>)
- <a id="fn-semgrep-ce-e7"></a>**Semgrep CE** yes: scan downloads Registry rules and uses community rules by default; maintained rules under Semgrep Rules License. [docs.semgrep.dev](<https://docs.semgrep.dev/getting-started/quickstart-ce>)
- <a id="fn-semgrep-pro-e7"></a>**Semgrep Pro** yes: Vendor-maintained Pro rules (about 60 for Kotlin to over 710 for Python) plus Community rules. [docs.semgrep.dev](<https://docs.semgrep.dev/supported-languages>)
- <a id="fn-joern-e7"></a>**Joern** yes: Joern Query Database ships with joern-scan, constantly updated; joern-scan --updatedb downloads the newest bundle [docs.joern.io](<https://docs.joern.io/scan/>)
- <a id="fn-infer-e7"></a>**Infer** yes: Ships documented checkers and issue types (Pulse, RacerD, bufferoverrun, starvation, cost and others) plus a default taint config. [fbinfer.com](<https://fbinfer.com/docs/all-issue-types>)
- <a id="fn-sonarqube-e7"></a>**SonarQube** yes: Ships rules by key per language (for example S3649 SQL injection taint, S2076 command injection), enabled through quality profiles. [docs.sonarsource.com](<https://docs.sonarsource.com/sonarqube-server/quality-standards-administration/managing-rules/security-related-rules>)
- <a id="fn-snyk-code-e7"></a>**Snyk Code** yes: Snyk Code security rules are listed per language with CWE mapping and are updated continuously. [docs.snyk.io](<https://docs.snyk.io/scan-fix-and-prevent/scan-with-snyk/snyk-code/snyk-code-security-rules>)
- <a id="fn-coverity-e7"></a>**Coverity** yes: Ships checkers mapped to MISRA, CERT, OWASP Top 10, CWE Top 25 and more; policy sets required checkers. [www.blackduck.com](<https://www.blackduck.com/static-analysis-tools-sast/coverity.html>)
- <a id="fn-doop-e7"></a>**Doop (Soufflé)** yes: Ships a collection of analyses as Datalog rules (context-insensitive and sensitive variants), P/Taint and JackEE entry-point rules [github.com](<https://github.com/plast-lab/doop>)
- <a id="fn-glean-e7"></a>**Glean** unknown: The page read does not say it. [glean.software](<https://glean.software/docs/introduction/>)
- <a id="fn-scip-e7"></a>**SCIP** no: Not a defect finder: scope is a code-navigation index; scip lint checks indexes, not source code. [raw.githubusercontent.com](<https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sourcegraph/scip/main/docs/DESIGN.md>)
- <a id="fn-go-analysis-e7"></a>**staticcheck / go/analysis** yes: Staticcheck ships '150+' checks in SA, S, ST and QF families; x/tools go/analysis/passes holds further analyzers. [staticcheck.dev](<https://staticcheck.dev/docs/>)
- <a id="fn-spotbugs-e7"></a>**SpotBugs** yes: Detectors page 'lists all detectors in SpotBugs' (over 100 headings); bug descriptions page catalogues patterns by category. [spotbugs.readthedocs.io](<https://spotbugs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/detectors.html>)
- <a id="fn-errorprone-e7"></a>**Error Prone** yes: Bug patterns page lists about 630 patterns, about 495 on by default, auto-generated from the sources. [errorprone.info](<https://errorprone.info/bugpatterns>)
- <a id="fn-clang-sa-e7"></a>**Clang SA / tidy** yes: clang-tidy lists about 600 entries including aliases (bugprone, cert, modernize and others); analyzer ships default checker packages. [clang.llvm.org](<https://clang.llvm.org/extra/clang-tidy/checks/list.html>)
- <a id="fn-capslock-e7"></a>**Capslock** yes: Ships built-in capability mappings of standard library packages and functions to capabilities, maintained in the repository. [raw.githubusercontent.com](<https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/capslock/main/docs/capabilities.md>)
- <a id="fn-ast-grep-e7"></a>**ast-grep** partial: Catalog "curates a list of example ast-grep rules to check and to rewrite Go code"; examples, per language. [ast-grep.github.io](<https://ast-grep.github.io/catalog/go/>)
- <a id="fn-openrewrite-e7"></a>**OpenRewrite** yes: Ships a large recipe catalogue (migrations, security fixes, style); some modules under MSAL or proprietary licences. [docs.openrewrite.org](<https://docs.openrewrite.org/>)
- <a id="fn-comby-e7"></a>**Comby** unknown: Configuration page mentions no catalogue or registry of prebuilt rules.
- <a id="fn-gritql-e7"></a>**GritQL** yes: README: 200+ standard patterns in a standard library repository, usable through the module system. [github.com](<https://github.com/getgrit/gritql>)
- <a id="fn-coccinelle-e7"></a>**Coccinelle** partial: Semantic patches ship in the Linux kernel scripts directory; coccicheck bundles a selection and the site hosts example rules. [coccinelle.gitlabpages.inria.fr](<https://coccinelle.gitlabpages.inria.fr/website/>)
